mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, take my temperature, and sit at the edge of the bed until I understand how I feel.
mara.intention: Assess my health before committing to the day.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into lounge clothes, and leave my work clothes and running shoes alone.
mara.intention: Get comfortable without spending energy on a normal work routine.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea with lemon and honey, carry the mug to the kitchen island, and eat toast with a little butter.
mara.intention: Have something warm and manageable before taking medicine or resting.

mara.activity: Carry the mug and plate to the sink, rinse them, and send brief messages cancelling the studio day and ceramics class, mentioning that I am still unwell.
mara.intention: Protect my recovery and avoid bringing an illness into the studio or class.

mara.activity: Return to bed with the curtains partly open, keep water and my phone nearby, and sleep or doze.
mara.intention: Let the fatigue settle instead of forcing productivity.

mara.activity: Check only urgent work messages and answer one presentation question if necessary, then put the phone back down.
mara.intention: Keep the client situation contained without reopening the workday.

mara.activity: Rest quietly in the living room with my feet up and listen to a quiet podcast.
mara.intention: Change rooms for a little air and light while conserving energy.

mara.activity: Make a small mug of ginger tea and carry it to the living room, then eat yogurt and a banana at the coffee table.
mara.intention: Take in a simple lunch without cooking.

mara.activity: Sleep or doze on the living room sectional with the lights soft, leaving the phone face down on the coffee table.
mara.intention: Give my body an uninterrupted block of rest.

mara.activity: Take cold medicine according to the label, drink water, and sit quietly before deciding whether I need anything else.
mara.intention: Manage symptoms carefully and avoid overestimating my energy.

mara.activity: Have a warm, brief shower, put on my evening sweater and lounge pants, and leave the towel in the bathroom to dry.
mara.intention: Refresh myself without turning it into a full evening routine.

mara.activity: Make scrambled eggs and toast at the island, then carry the plate and water glass to the living room.
mara.intention: Eat a modest, nourishing dinner rather than ordering or attempting a complicated meal.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional and keep conversation brief if Julian and his chef friend are nearby; welcome the friend warmly, then excuse myself when the professional talk becomes tiring.
mara.intention: Be hospitable without spending the energy I need to recover.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and glass back to the kitchen, rinse them, and wipe the island once.
mara.intention: Leave only a small amount of cleanup for myself and keep the kitchen usable.

mara.activity: Return to bed, keep the lights low, and read only if I can stay awake comfortably.
mara.intention: Wind down without trying to recover lost work time.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, make a final small mug of ginger tea, and carry it with water to the bed.
mara.intention: Settle into a warm, early bedtime.

mara.activity: Put my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, set my phone beside them, and turn off the light.
mara.intention: Keep the bedside clear and sleep as soon as I can.

mara.activity: Sleep and allow myself a full recovery night.

julian.activity: Make quiet coffee and a small breakfast at the kitchen island. I grind the coffee beans, pour milk into a mug, eat a banana, and skim the restaurant notebook without starting any major planning.
julian.intention: Keep the morning calm and familiar before work.

julian.activity: Rinse the mug and breakfast things, wipe the island, fill my thermos, and pack my backpack. I check that my phone and wallet are with me, then take my keys from the piano’s middle shelf.
julian.intention: Leave the house prepared without disturbing Mara’s morning routine.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, and kitchen management. I check produce and temperatures, organize the prep list, speak with the manager, and portion ingredients for the evening service.
julian.intention: Keep the kitchen orderly and protect enough energy for dinner service.

julian.activity: Return home, carry the thermos to the kitchen beside the sink, and put my keys on the piano’s middle shelf. I leave my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, eat yogurt and drink water, then sit quietly for a short reset.
julian.intention: Recover physically before the long evening rather than filling the gap with chores.

julian.activity: Change into fresh work clothes and check the evening service notes. I tuck receipts into the restaurant notebook, take the knife roll from the lower kitchen cabinet shelf, and pack it into my backpack.
julian.intention: Make the transition back to work deliberate and avoid last-minute scrambling.

julian.activity: Travel back to the restaurant and settle into the kitchen before service, carrying the packed knife roll and thermos.
julian.intention: Arrive with a few minutes to breathe and review the line.

julian.activity: Run dinner service and closing duties. I lead the pass, taste sauces, manage timing, finish the closing checklist, and keep the restaurant team moving through cleanup.
julian.intention: Deliver a strong service while leaving enough attention for my friend later.

julian.activity: Come home, return my keys to the piano’s middle shelf, set my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, and carry the thermos to the kitchen beside the sink. I wash my hands and change out of my jacket.
julian.intention: Make the house feel calm before welcoming the visiting chef.

julian.activity: Sit with my chef friend in the living room for a brief drink and unhurried conversation about the collaborative event, service pressures, and the dishes that worked. I bring two mugs and a bowl of fruit from the kitchen, then carry them back when we finish.
julian.intention: Offer the kind of easy professional companionship that needs no explanation, while keeping the visit contained and considerate of Mara.

julian.activity: Say goodnight to my friend, take a hot shower, dry off, and change into sleep clothes. I leave the towel hanging in the bathroom and keep the lights low.
julian.intention: Shift out of restaurant energy and into a familiar recovery routine.

julian.activity: Eat a small bowl of yogurt, rinse the bowl and water glass, plug my phone into the nightstand charger, and get into bed beside Mara without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Finish the day with minimal decisions and protect sleep after service.
